identity.real_world_identity_notes: Customer GT3 racing car on the 992 generation 911, with a 4.2 litre flat six. Porsche specifies a sequential six-speed constant-mesh gearbox derived from the 911 GT3 Cup, with paddles driving an electronic shift drum actuator.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: clutch-free move-off, six paddle-selected gears, and automatic cut and blip.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip. This matches every other curated paddle-shift GT3 car.

driver_summary: Paddle sequential that asks for no clutch at any point: it gets away from rest, cuts the upshift and blips the downshift itself. Once you are in the car the gearbox is not your problem.
